query:
SELECT js.*, j.competenceMonth, j.status 
FROM journalSources js 
LEFT JOIN journals j ON js.journalId = j.id 
WHERE js.sourceType = 'expense' AND js.sourceId = (SELECT id FROM expenses WHERE docNumber = '07202603437463826')
